topic: ACT及动作分块策略在RoboTwin 2.0中的接入、训练与闭环评测

stopping_rule.note: Stop only when every requirement passes; source-count floors alone never establish coverage.

notes: llm dynamic expansion (high): ACT–RoboTwin 是窄方法与特定基准的交叉问题，需要显式扩展到动作分块、执行调度、多任务双臂操作和域随机化评测。

dynamic_suggestions.why: 捕获直接同时使用 ACT 与 RoboTwin 的研究。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-adaptive-replanning
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:"adaptive action chunking" OR all:"execution horizon" OR all:replanning) AND all:"robot policy"
dynamic_suggestions.why: 覆盖固定执行窗的反例、自适应重规划和响应性—连续性权衡。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-temporal-aggregation
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:"temporal aggregation" OR all:"temporal ensembling") AND all:"robot manipulation"
dynamic_suggestions.why: 覆盖 ACT 部署中跨动作块融合和平滑执行的核心接口。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-multitask-bimanual-act
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:"Action Chunking Transformer" OR all:"MoE-ACT") AND all:"multi-task" AND all:bimanual
dynamic_suggestions.why: 覆盖 ACT 的多任务、语言条件和双臂变体。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-robotwin-bimanual-benchmark
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"RoboTwin 2.0" AND all:bimanual AND (all:benchmark OR all:evaluation)
dynamic_suggestions.why: 补齐 RoboTwin 2.0 任务、域随机化和评测边界。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-robotwin-policy-adapter
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:RoboTwin AND (all:deployment OR all:adapter OR all:interface) AND all:policy
dynamic_suggestions.why: 寻找策略包装器、观测编码和动作交付的工程证据。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-robotwin-domain-randomization
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:RoboTwin AND all:"domain randomization" AND all:policy
dynamic_suggestions.why: 捕获干净设置与困难随机化设置之间的鲁棒性落差。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-action-chunk-runtime-monitor
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"action chunk" AND (all:monitor OR all:failure OR all:intervention) AND all:robot
dynamic_suggestions.why: 覆盖动作块执行时的失败检测、插手和闭环安全。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-robotwin-act-browser
dynamic_suggestions.query: site:arxiv.org/abs RoboTwin ACT action chunking robot
dynamic_suggestions.why: API 检索不足时捕获直接交叉论文。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-action-chunking-browser
dynamic_suggestions.query: site:arxiv.org/abs adaptive action chunk execution replanning robot
dynamic_suggestions.why: 捕获新的动作块执行别名和方法。

calibration_notes: arxiv calibration (high): DVAC uses denoising variance to adapt the executed prefix and replanning point.
arxiv calibration (high): PACE uses phase-aware chunk execution and evaluates on 50 RoboTwin 2.0 tasks.
arxiv calibration (high): AAC uses action entropy for inference-time adaptive chunk sizing.
arxiv calibration (high): Recent mechanism study frames implicit ensembling and non-Markovian expressivity as chunking benefits.
official-context calibration (medium): RoboTwin's current terminology is ACT data preprocessing, policy training, evaluation, and temporal aggregation.
